analysis.title: Macro at a Glance: Latest views and forecasts
key_insights: GS raised its December 2026 Brent forecast to $90/bbl from $85/bbl because of ongoing downside risks to oil supply. Brent last traded at $106, with GS at $95 for 4Q26 and $87 for 1Q27.

GS raised its 2026/2027 China PPI forecasts to 2.8%/0.3% yoy from 2.0%/0.0% after September PPI came in stronger than expected. It lowered its 2026/2027 China CPI forecasts to 0.8%/0.6% yoy from 1.0%/1.0% on weak domestic demand and a likely fading energy boost next year.

GS expects global real GDP growth to slow to 2.6% yoy in 2026 because of higher energy prices from the Middle East conflict. Global core inflation is expected to end the year at 2.8%, with shelter and wage inflation normalizing, energy passthrough adding to prices, and tariff effects fading.

GS expects US real GDP growth of 2.3% Q4/Q4 in 2026, largely from the continued AI boom. Core PCE is expected to fall to 3.0% Q4/Q4 in 2026 and closer to 2% in 2027 as tariff, energy passthrough and AI demand effects fade. Unemployment is expected to end 2026 at 4.2%.
GS expects one more 25bp Fed hike in December, taking the policy range to a peak of 4.00-4.25%.

GS expects Euro area real GDP growth of 1.0% Q4/Q4 in 2026, with energy prices and subdued consumer confidence as headwinds and improvement next year. Core inflation is expected to peak at 2.7% yoy in 1Q27 and decline to 2.0% by end-2028.
GS expects the ECB to deliver one more 25bp hike in December, taking the policy rate to a peak of 2.75%.

GS expects China real GDP growth of 4.5% yoy in 2026, with export strength offset by weak domestic demand. China CPI/PPI are expected to rise to 0.8%/2.8% yoy this year, mostly from commodity price passthrough.
GS flags the Middle East conflict as the main watch item, in particular regional energy exports and demand for that energy from consumers such as China.

GS market forecasts: US 10-year yield 4.75% at end-2026 and 4.40% at end-2027 (last 5.21%). EUR/$ 1.14 in 3 months and 1.12 in 12 months (last 1.12). $/JPY 158 in 3 months and 150 in 12 months (last 158). Gold $4,605 in 4Q26 and $4,765 in 1Q27 (last $4,170). Copper $13,700 in 4Q26 (last $14,694).
GS S&P 500 forecast: price target 8,000, E2026 EPS $375 against consensus $366, E2027 EPS $415 against consensus $423. Forward P/E is 22.2x.
earnings_insights: GS S&P 500 EPS forecast (estimate, not reported) is $375 for 2026 against consensus $366, and $415 for 2027 against consensus $423. GS EPS growth is 36% in 2026 and 11% in 2027 against consensus 33% and 16%.
